examples.label: Example 1
examples.input:
8
t to top tops ta tap tape ok
examples.display:
words  = ["t", "to", "top", "tops", "ta", "tap", "tape", "ok"]
output = "tape"

"tops" is as long, but "tape" comes first. "ok" cannot be built: "o" is missing.
